text: ああ　みえても　オーキドはかせは　ポケモンの　オーソリティなの！

structure.en: even though he looks like that

structure.jp: ポケモンの　オーソリティなの！

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: も after a て-form means 'even if' or 'even though'. ああ みえても = 'even though he looks like that'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end adds the feel of explaining; なの is the soft, womanly form used after a noun. オーソリティなの = 'he is an authority, you know'.
